changelog: Add isolated per-skill virtualenv entrypoints (scripts/x_publisher and scripts/post_thread): provision a shared .venv on first run and auto-install tweepy (now declared in requirements.txt). SKILL.md, README, and CLAUDE.md updated to invoke the wrappers; no manual pip install needed.
summary: Publish tweets to X (Twitter) using the official Tweepy library. Supports text-only tweets, tweets with images or videos, and returns detailed publish results including tweet ID and URL. Requires X API credentials (API Key, API Secret, Access Token, Access Token Secret).
